name: Operator Workflow Design Final Closure Panel
purpose: Shows whether Operator Workflow Design v1.5 can close from aggregate workflow evidence.
accessibility: Expose final closure status, selected task, selected workflow, handoff target, decision, summary, artifacts, evidence, checks, blockers, and next workflow as visible text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate blocked or closed closure state.
Keep closure checks and release artifacts readable so operators can audit why v1.5 is open or closed.
